module: UI helper for the flowgraph editor (ui_flowgraph_editor). It integrates the node engine API (editor_api_luaintf), defines the colors/icons of node categories and pin types, the styles of graph types (state, graph, macro, instance), value display utilities, a variable editor, a vehicle selector and tests on node behavior categories. Useful to a modder writing a custom flowgraph node or ImGui tool.
notes: types[type].icon is filled with typeIcons[type] or M.IconType_Circle; M.IconType_Circle comes from fge.enum, but the getTypeIcon() accessor returns an icon name (string) or M.detaultIconType ("fg_type_circle"), not the enum value: the two sources are therefore not consistent.
fullValueString does not handle the 'boolean' type (only 'bool'), unlike shortValueString: a value typed 'boolean' returns "???" in the full version.
The field detaultIconType is written with this typo (detault) in the code.
tooltip() displays nothing if editor_flowgraphEditor.allowTooltip is false.
The comment of the flowgraphVersion field in the auto page comes from a commented-out print; the value is 0.2 (0.1: until the April 2021 release; 0.2: flat lists for graphs).
Recognized node categories: repeat_/once_/dynamic_ combined with instant, p_duration, f_duration, plus 'simple' and 'provider'.

flowgraphVersion.desc: Flowgraph format version (0.2: flat lists for graphs).

nodeColors.desc: Color per node category (crash, ai, debug, vehicle, event, ui, camera, scene, default, career, traffic...).

nodeIcons.desc: Icon name per node category (vehicle, ai, camera, ui, event, scene, state, thread, logic, traffic, debug, button, timer, file, career, tech...).

defaultTypeIconSize.desc: Default size of pin type icons: 18.

getSimpleTypes.desc: Returns the list of simple types: number, bool, string, vec3, quat, color.

getTypes.desc: Returns the table of pin types with their color and icon.

getTypeColor.desc: ImGui color of a pin type; brown (0.45, 0.35, 0.1, 1) if the type is unknown.

dataType.desc: Pin type (flow, chainFlow, impulse, string, number, bool, any, table, vec3, quat, color, state).

getTypeIcon.desc: Icon name of a pin type, or "fg_type_circle" by default.

getGraphTypes.desc: Returns the styles of the graph types (state, graph, macro, instance): name, color, tab colors, gridColor, abbreviation.

tooltip.desc: Displays an ImGui tooltip for the hovered item, only if editor_flowgraphEditor.allowTooltip is true.

shortValueString.desc: Short representation of a value according to its type: strings truncated to 10 characters + "...", numbers to 2 decimals, vec3/quat/color with 1 decimal; "(nil)" if nil, "Flowing / Not Flowing" for flow, "???" if the type is not handled. If the type is absent/any/table, it is guessed.

tpe.desc: Pin type; guessed if nil, any or table.

shortDisplay.desc: Displays shortValueString in ImGui (im.Text); for a color type, first draws a small colored square. Displays "nil" if the value is nil.

fullValueString.desc: Like shortValueString but without truncation: numbers in %f format, vec3/quat/color with %f. Returns "nil" if nil.

tpe.desc: Pin type; guessed if nil, any or table.

fullDisplay.desc: Displays fullValueString in ImGui; for a color type, first draws a colored square.

variableEditor.desc: Draws an ImGui widget to edit a flowgraph variable (string, number, etc. according to variable.type) from source:getFull(name); also offers rename/delete via a context menu. Displays "Variable X not found!" if absent. In edit mode, changes the base value (changeBase) and adds a history entry; otherwise changes the current value (changeInstant).

source.desc: Object holding the variables (graph or manager) with getFull, changeBase, changeInstant, renameVariable, mgr.

vehicleSelectorRefresh.desc: Updates self.modelName and self.configName (and self.configs sorted by name) from self.model / self.config / self.models.

self.desc: Selection object (fields model, config, models, configs).

onlyModel.desc: Not used in the function body.

vehicleSelector.desc: Draws an ImGui vehicle selector: "Load Models and Configs" button (loads core_vehicles.getModelList), text search and choice of model then config. Updates self.model, self.config, self.vehType, self.modelName, self.configName. Returns a change reason (reason) or nil.

onlyModel.desc: If true, only picks the model, not the configuration.

returns.desc: Reason for the change (not checked in detail).

isFunctionalNode.desc: True for the categories repeat/once/dynamic × instant/p_duration/f_duration as well as 'simple' and 'provider'.

isSimpleNode.desc: True for 'simple' and 'provider' (nodes that do not need flow).

isDurationNode.desc: True for the categories *_p_duration and *_f_duration (repeat, once, dynamic).

isF_DurationNode.desc: True for the categories *_f_duration (repeat, once, dynamic).

getBehaviourIcon.desc: Icon of a node behavior: once, duration, simple, singleActive, obsolete; nil otherwise.

getBehaviourDescription.desc: English text describing a node behavior (once, duration, simple, singleActive, obsolete); nil otherwise.

getAutoTypeFromName.desc: Guesses the pin type from the (lowercase) name: pos/scl/vec/position/scale/vector -> vec3; rot/quat/rotation/orientation -> quat; clr/color -> color; num/id/number/amount/score/count/time/duration/length/dist/points/threshold/velocity -> number; bool/enabled/disabled/contains/has.../uses.../with... -> bool; otherwise string.
